gt_provenance.details: ESMFold-predicted structures, not experimental GT (same as main experiment, no new issue). pydssp confirmed genuinely independent of mkdssp's output.

score_normalization.details: Simple means over gate-passing samples; no self-referential normalization.

result_existence.details: All 10 result JSONs + sequence JSONLs exist; consolidated numbers match raw files exactly.

dead_code.details: All computed quantities saved/aggregated (not dead code); minor asymmetry: n_resolved always from mkdssp path; retained sample set is intersection of both tools' successes (defensible but could mask per-tool failure-rate differences).

scope.details: Fair as a targeted SS-assignment robustness check (5 doses x 2 seeds x n=150 = 10 cells), not a full replication of the main experiment's 8x3 grid. Steering hook/feature set/prompts/predictor substantially confirmed identical from code.

reviewer_rationale: No fabrication, no self-normalization, all cells present and consistent. WARN driven by scope framing (targeted check, not full replication) and two minor dead-code/selectivity asymmetries -- none rise to FAIL.
